'''Pavo Prime''' was a [[Temperature/Legends|warm]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

==History==
Pavo Prime joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] early in its history, sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

It was also the home of several species of [[Fish/Legends|fish]], some of which were displayed in an aquarium in the lobby of a [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[43 ABY]].
